S25.04.needs: a signed-in AGI Cloud account with at least one code artifact
S25.04.note: The code only covers AI-produced artifacts, not workspace source files; the tab language comes from the artifact's language or type, not from the file on disk.
steps: Sign in to AGI Cloud if asked. Artifacts belong to that account.
Press Cmd+Shift+P, type "Code: Show Artifacts" and press Enter.
Pick an artifact that holds source code (its row shows a code type) and press Enter.
Look at the opened tab: it should show as a read-only text tab with syntax colouring for the code language, the same as Expected.
S25.04.where: Command palette (Cmd+Shift+P) > Code: Show Artifacts > pick a code artifact

labels.text: Code: Send Selection to a New Chat

S25.20.needs: a file open in the editor; a signed-in account to send the chat (not confirmed in the code)
S25.20.note: "Code: Send Selection to a New Chat" starts a new chat and resets the current conversation; if a reply is still being written it asks first.
steps: Open any source file in the editor.
Select a few lines of text with the mouse.
Right-click the selection and choose "Code: Send Selection to a New Chat" (or press Cmd+Shift+Alt+E for "Code: Explain Selection").
Look at the chat composer: it should show a reference to the file and the selected range, with an empty place to type your question. Type a question and send it to compare with Expected.
S25.20.where: Open a file > select some text > right-click the selection > Code: Send Selection to a New Chat

labels.text: Code: Send Selection to a New Chat

S25.21.needs: a file open in the editor with several lines; a signed-in account to send the chat (not confirmed in the code)
S25.21.note: The code has no page selection; it only handles text ranges in a text editor, so a page of a PDF or a page break is not covered.
steps: Open a long file in the editor.
Select a range of lines, for example from line 10 to line 20.
Right-click the selection and choose "Code: Send Selection to a New Chat".
Look at the chat composer: the file reference should carry the selected start and end lines. Type a question about that range and compare with Expected.
S25.21.where: Open a file > select a range of lines > right-click the selection > Code: Send Selection to a New Chat

S25.28.needs: a signed-in AGI Cloud account with at least one artifact
S25.28.note: The copy command copies the whole artifact, not a selected part; no code path copies a selection from a preview tab, so Expected (selected content) is not matched by the code.
steps: Sign in to AGI Cloud if asked.
Press Cmd+Shift+P, type "Code: Show Artifacts" and press Enter.
Click the copy icon on an artifact row. Its tooltip reads "Copy the content".
Paste somewhere (Cmd+V). The whole artifact text should appear, and a notice should say it was copied; compare with Expected.
S25.28.where: Command palette > Code: Show Artifacts > click the copy icon on an artifact row (tooltip Copy the content)
